detail.longDescription: I vanished for a bit and returned in the traditional manner: by redesigning the entire website for absolutely no reason. Terminal Princess is dead. Long live brutalism: fewer rounded corners, more concrete, structurally necessary pink. Also: 2.1 million scraper challenges, one miserable Forgejo, and the PoW equivalent of putting a claymore behind the front door before bed. https:// augustini.wtf/fieldnotes/my-gi t-forge-issued-2-million-challenges/ # SelfHosting # Forgejo # Kubernetes # Anubis # Brutalism
